# 🎡 Hyper Fetch GraphQL

GraphQL adapter for HyperFetch. Typed queries, mutations, and subscriptions.

## 📖 About This adapter connects HyperFetch to GraphQL APIs. You get typed queries, mutations, and subscriptions that work with HyperFetch's caching, queuing, and React hooks — the same request patterns you use for REST, but with GraphQL operations. ## 🎯 Key Capabilities - 🎡 **GraphQL meets HyperFetch** — Typed queries, mutations, and subscriptions with cache and queue support - 🔮 **End-to-end types** — Full TypeScript types for operations, variables, and responses - 📡 **Any GraphQL server** — Compatible with Apollo, Yoga, Hasura, and any spec-compliant endpoint - ⚛️ **React-ready** — Use

for GraphQL operations in components
- 💾 **Smart caching included** — Cache and offline support work the same as REST — no extra config
